title: Decoding-Level Taboo: A Diagnostic Stress Test for LLM Robustness
abstract: arXiv:2608.09900v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language model evaluations typically focus on performance under nominal conditions, creating an illusion of capability where models comfortably walk a narrow, highly optimized generation corridor. In real-world deployments, however, complex system prompts, safety guardrails, and structural constraints continuously force models off this nominal path, driving a divergence between benchmark scores and deployment performance. To address this issue, we introduce Decoding-Level Taboo, a zero-prompt diagnostic stress test that intervenes directly in logit space at runtime, forcing models out of their nominal paths. By dynamically masking primary candidate tokens at word boundaries, Taboo forces machine circumlocution. translated_title: 解码层面的禁忌：大语言模型鲁棒性的诊断压力测试
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.09900v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：大语言模型评估通常关注在名义条件下的性能，这造成了一种能力假象，即模型舒适地行走在一条狭窄、高度优化的生成走廊中。然而，在实际部署中，复杂的系统提示、安全护栏和结构约束不断迫使模型偏离这条名义路径，导致基准分数与部署性能之间的差异。为解决此问题，我们引入了“解码层面的禁忌”，这是一种零提示诊断压力测试，在运行时直接干预logit空间，迫使模型偏离其名义路径。通过在词边界动态屏蔽主要候选词元，禁忌迫使机器进行迂回表达。对多个开放权重模型系列的评估表明，离路径鲁棒性受参数规模和训练后的指令对齐显著影响，且鲁棒性通常随规模增大而改善。
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为“解码层面的禁忌”的零提示压力测试方法，通过运行时在logit空间动态屏蔽主要候选词元，迫使大语言模型偏离其名义生成路径，从而诊断其鲁棒性，并发现参数规模和指令对齐是关键影响因素。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "Decoding-Level Taboo," a zero-prompt stress test that intervenes in logit space at runtime to force LLMs off their nominal paths, revealing that robustness is heavily influenced by parameter scale and instruction alignment.
